title: Invoice matching
bodyMd:
Invoices match automatically only if supplier, amount, and purchase-order fields agree. All other invoices require manual handling.

| Category | Invoices | Automatic matches |
|---|---:|---:|
| Domestic | 100 | 90 |
| Regional | 150 | 120 |
| Overseas | 250 | 175 |
